audience: sales teams that keep companies, leads, deals and follow-up tasks in RAYNET CRM

useCases.title: Look up a company and its contacts
useCases.text: Search the companies by name, then open one to read its details and addresses. List the contact persons to find who to call.

useCases.title: Review the business deals
useCases.text: List the business deals with search and paging, and open one to read its details. Read the product catalogue for the offer.

useCases.title: Check leads and who owns them
useCases.text: Search the sales leads and open one to read its status. List the user accounts to see who owns each lead or task.

useCases.title: Review the tasks
useCases.text: Search the tasks with paging and open one to read its details.

useCases.title: Add a lead and a follow-up task
useCases.text: Create a lead with its topic and priority. Then create a task for its owner and link the task to the lead by its ID.
